name: native-cjs-startup
goal: Native main and preload bundles parse as CommonJS before launch; exclude browser-only SDK runtime from server token minting

evidence: GameRenderService runtime SDK import introduced browser worker import.meta into CommonJS main bundle; native launch threw SyntaxError before creating a window.
Bun result.success checked bundling only; the native test timed out and startup logs were not inspected. The normal build now parses both main and preload with Node before success.
node --check packages/desktop/dist/main.cjs and guarded build:main both failed at WORKER_URL import.meta. Logs: /tmp/harness-native-bundle-red.log and /tmp/harness-native-guard-red.log.
Use server-only HTTP token minting with header credentials; retain disabled live-video boundary. Parse every CommonJS native artifact in the existing build command.
Removed server runtime SDK import, added bounded header-auth token HTTP request and native build Node syntax guard for main and preload.
The unchanged guarded build passes; five game-host tests pass. Native app opens, selects the committed test game, and loads key, door, garden and vault image assets.
An isolated copy of the original bundle /tmp/harness-native-before.cjs fails the identical node --check command at import.meta after the repaired bundles pass. No user app profile was cleared.
